subject: Post-demo: MedNexus evaluation plan & dataset/score checklist
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@mednexus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-14T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: evaluation proposal and next steps

Hi Laura — great running through the demo this morning. Thanks for sharing the sample flows and the annotated failure cases; that was super helpful for sizing the evaluation. Quick summary + proposed plan to validate model fit on Redwood: 

Summary of goals
- Primary goal: extract structured clinical attributes and actionables from inbound clinician notes with >92% macro-F1 on our gold labels.
- Secondary goals: robust PII redaction (PII recall >= 0.98), and zero-high-severity hallucinations on medication-dosing statements.

Recommended model candidates (for the initial run on Redwood)
- Falcon-40B-Instruct (dense) — baseline for throughput and prompt reliability.
- Llama-3-70B (q4_x4 suggested quantized variant) — best tradeoff for quality per token for long-context notes.
- Redwood fine-tune (small domain adapter on L3-70B) — if baseline evaluations show systematic edge cases.

Proposed evaluation deliverables
1) Redwood-hosted benchmark run using your 2k labeled rows (you mentioned ~2k) and our scoring script.
2) Prompt set (sample attached) covering 8 clinical intents + 14 extraction fields.
3) Scoring rubric: macro-F1 for extractions, token-level PII recall, and a 5-point human rating for hallucination severity (we'll provide annotation UI).

What we need from you to kick off
- A sample export: 200 de-identified rows + 50 labeled rows in the attached MedNexus_eval_template.csv format.
- A named point of contact for security: procurement@mednexus.ai or a SOC2 reviewer who can sign the NDA/Security Addendum.
- Confirmation if you prefer Redwood-hosted evals (fast turnaround) or Private deployment in your AWS account (requires infra setup).

Next steps and timeline
- If you hand off the sample and confirm hosted vs private by EOD Friday (2026-01-16), we can return preliminary numbers within 5 business days.
- I'll loop in Marissa (solutions eng) to detail dataset format and scoring scripts.
- I'll share a short SOW draft for procurement review (attached).

Attachments: MedNexus_eval_template.csv, SOW-draft-Redwood.pdf, prompt_set_sample.txt

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <laura@mednexus.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@mednexus.ai>
Date: 2026-01-14T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: evaluation proposal and next steps

Hi Vivek — thanks for the clear write-up and the attachments. A couple of quick clarifications from our side: 

1) PII concerns: our security team is explicit that any hosted eval with customer data needs at minimum encrypted at-rest + SOC2 Type II; we saw Redwood is SOC2, can you confirm the retention policy for uploaded evaluation datasets?

2) Dataset size: the 2k figure includes both labeled and unlabeled notes — we can provide 300 labeled rows for scoring and the rest can be unlabeled for model selection. Would that be enough for a first pass?

3) Private deployment ask: we would prefer the evaluation to run in our AWS account if possible (for legal/regulatory reasons). If that's doable, what infra access and timeline should we expect?

I'll coordinate with Procurement on the SOW review; looping them on this thread.

—Laura
Laura Chen | Head of Clinical AI, MedNexus
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@mednexus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@mednexus.ai>
Date: 2026-01-14T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: evaluation proposal and next steps

Laura — great questions, answers inline below. Also copied Marissa to start technical coordination.

1) Retention & security: Redwood-hosted evals inherit our data retention defaults: uploaded benchmark artifacts are retained for 30 days by default, and we can set a shorter retention window (7 days) for eval buckets. All uploads are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS1.2+). We will provide a signed Security Addendum + SOC2 summary for Procurement.

2) Dataset size: 300 labeled rows is enough to produce initial precision/recall numbers for the targeted fields; suggest reserving ~100 labeled rows as a holdout for a final sanity check. The 1.7k unlabeled rows are good for sample-length distribution and stress testing.

3) Private deployment: yes — we can run the eval in your AWS account using our Private agent (Redwood Private). Requirements: a short CFN template or Terraform snippet we provide, a temporary IAM role for the test-run (limited to S3 read/write and EKS launch), and an SRE window to coordinate (usually 2 business days to spin up). Timeline: once IAM role is available, initial cluster + artifact sync takes ~48 hours, run completes in 48–72 hours depending on queue.

Next steps: 
- Laura: confirm hosted vs private by EOD Friday 2026-01-16 (you mentioned coordinating with Procurement).
- Procurement: if private, please confirm point-of-contact for IAM and we will share a minimal infra playbook.
- Marissa: can you add the dataset format checklist and scoring rubrics inline here?

Thanks — Vivek
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@mednexus.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@mednexus.ai>
Date: 2026-01-15T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: evaluation proposal and next steps

Hi Laura / Vivek — adding the technical checklist below so procurement/infra can triage quickly. I'm attaching a sample prompt set and minimal scoring script (prompt_set_sample.txt).

Dataset format checklist (MedNexus_eval_template.csv)
- Required columns: id, note_text, label_json (JSON string of expected extractions), source_date (ISO), deid_flag (true/false).
- Max tokenization length guidance: prefer notes < 4,000 tokens; for longer notes include a ‘summary_context’ field.
- Field-level labels: use canonicalized keys (diagnosis_code, medication_name, dosage, instruction) to map to our scorer.
- PII redaction test rows: include 25 rows with synthetic PII (we'll surface PII recall).

Scoring rubric (high level)
- Extraction: macro-F1 across all extraction keys.
- PII redaction: token-level recall and a secondary metric: percent of records with any PII left unredacted (goal < 2%).
- Hallucination: human raters (3 raters) score each model output on a 1–5 scale for factuality; we flag any 4–5 as high severity.

Prompt set notes
- Provide 6 canonical prompts covering: extraction, summarization, action item generation, medication normalization, question-answering over note, and redaction verification. See attached prompt_set_sample.txt for exact prompts.

Infra notes for Private eval in your AWS account
- We'll supply a CloudFormation snippet that creates an ephemeral EKS namespace and an S3 bucket with encryption. We only need IAM: s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject (scoped to the bucket), sts:AssumeRole for the ephemeral task role.
- Expected cost footprint: a 2-node g5 cluster for 72 hours (testing + cleanup).

If you confirm private, Ben (cc'd) will pick up the DocuSign/SOW once Procurement confirms billing details.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Vivek / Marissa — thanks, Procurement here. We reviewed the SOW-draft and are OK with a private-run in our AWS account provided: 
- Redwood provides the minimal CFN/TF and an exact IAM policy we can hand to our security team.
- Data retention is set to 7 days for the eval bucket and a certificate of deletion after completion.

Timeline: we can provide the role and merge point-of-contact Tuesday 2026-01-20. Please confirm you'll start infra setup then; we prefer evaluation to complete before our steering committee on 2026-01-28.

Action items: 
- Redwood: send CFN snippet + IAM policy and the signed Security Addendum.
- MedNexus: we'll hand off the role once we have the IAM policy details.

Thanks — Procurement
